Claim 1 (Currently Amended): An assembly comprising a test tube with an affixed MTP, the MTP being embedded into the test tube material.

Claim 2 (Currently Amended): The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in the test tube and positioned such that it does not interfere with the contents of the test tube.

Claim 3 (Currently Amended): The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded at a bottom side portion of the test tube, oriented for reading downwards and situated above the bottom surface of the test tube by a distance sufficient to avoid direct contact with the test tube’s contents.

Claim 4 (Original): The assembly of claim 1, wherein the test tube is a biorepository test tube.

Claim 5 (Original): The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer.

Claim 6 (Currently Amended): The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom portion of the test tube.

Claim 22 (Currently Amended): The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is embedded at a bottom side portion of the test tube, oriented for reading downwards and situated above the bottom surface of the test tube by a distance sufficient to avoid direct contact with the test tube’s contents.

Claim 23 (Currently Amended): The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is embedded at a bottom side portion of the test tube, oriented for reading downwards and situated above the bottom surface of the test tube by a distance sufficient to avoid direct contact with the test tube’s contents.
